front_page_meta_title: Bruut OpenAgbot | Open-source field robot for farmers and makers
front_page_meta_desc: Bruut is an open-source, electric tool carrier for farmers and makers. Four versions, 44 functions and five implements fully worked out in FreeCAD.
front_page_hero_title: A field robot you build yourself
front_page_hero_desc: An electric tool carrier for farmers and makers. Built from standard parts you buy, understand and repair yourself.
front_page_hero_alt: The Bruut prototype in a grass field, with two GNSS antennas on a mast
front_page_hero_cad_alt: The same robot frame as a FreeCAD model
front_page_hero_caption: The prototype in the field, and the same frame as a FreeCAD model.
front_page_fact_1: open source: designs, code and calculations
front_page_fact_3: versions, from 1.1 to 8.4 kW motor power
front_page_fact_4: functions, 5 of them worked out in FreeCAD
front_page_start_title: Where do you want to start?
front_page_card_functions: 44 implements and applications, from overseeder to wildlife deterrent. Five are worked out down to the bolt, with calculations and animations.
front_page_card_build: The hole-grid frame, the wheel units and the steering heads. All built from standard parts.
front_page_card_build_alt: The bare robot frame on four wheel units in the workshop
front_page_card_goal: Why we make agricultural robotics open, simple and affordable.
front_page_card_configurator: Put together your own robot: wheels, frame, control and battery.
front_page_versions_desc: The same frame and the same software. You choose how much pulling force you need and what you want to spend.
front_page_impl_desc: Every design is parametric: change a dimension and the whole model follows. With calculations, drawings and an animation on the robot.
front_page_slide_robot_text: Ackermann steering with stepper motors: straight ahead, a 90° turn and straight again.
front_page_origin_p1: Bruut was started by Jan Jaap Verweij, dairy farmer and lead contributor to the open-source projects CowCatcher and CalvingCatcher.
front_page_origin_p2: After computer vision in the barn came the step into robotics: a simple field robot for less chemistry, lower fuel and machinery costs and less heavy work. Spot spraying, mechanical weeding and better soil health come first.
front_page_origin_alt: Dairy farmer in the barn, between the cows at the feed fence
front_page_team_desc: You start on your own. That is exactly the strength of open source: in no time there is a team, and everyone brings their own strength.
front_page_team_member_3_role: Dairy farmer / Full stack dev / founder
front_page_team_member_4_role: Dairy farmer / Vegetable grower / former mechanic
front_page_youtube_desc: Welding, wiring, the first autonomous rows and the tests that went wrong. A new video every few weeks.
front_page_join_desc: Share your implement, improve the code or start building your own Bruut. Companies that want to support the project are welcome as partners.
